groups.activity: Howl of the Kubrow, then Incubator access
infect a Warframe with the Helminth Cyst

rows.label: matured Helminth Cyst
rows.note: Nidus: sit in the Helminth chair once; no Helminth Segment needed
rows.alt: or stand near an infected Warframe in a mission, dojo or Orbiter

conditions: Start this first: the cyst shows 24 hours after infection and matures 6 days after that, on real time, while the frame sits in your arsenal.
A second sit in the chair removes the cyst, and choosing Remove cyst on any frame makes it permanently immune.
The Coda infection's pink growth is a different thing; only a matured Helminth Cyst unlocks Drain.
bonuses: Without Nidus, run public missions on a spare frame; infection spreads fast in public squads.
Draining doesn't cure the cyst, so the same frame can make more Chargers later.

disclosures.title: when the cyst never shows
disclosures.body: A cyst on Nidus can bug out: one player had the chair offering Remove cyst with no visible cyst after more than a week. The advice was to get a different frame infected by another player and use that one. The cyst is mature when a tendril sticks out of it.

conditions: The blueprint is a reusable 50,000-credit Market purchase.
Equip the infected frame, then press Drain at the start of incubation; once an egg is already incubating the option is gone and it hatches a normal Kubrow.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment.
If it won't equip after maturing (Missing Collar), relog or start any mission.
bonuses: It is the only companion that can use the Strain mod set. Its Helminth Claws level but give no Mastery.

disclosures.title: size is random
disclosures.body: Chargers roll different sizes, and a big one with the Strain set can stand taller than your Warframe. Rerolling takes another cyst drain, egg and core. It can't equip Mecha Overdrive even though it's classed as a Kubrow.
